note: NOT PRODUCTION. /dʒ/-recovery + isolated-/v/ audition. The winning candidate per group is ported into production + re-baked in a separate follow-up PR after Thomas ear-tests.

groups.title: Deliverable 1 — /dʒ/ blend recovery (jam · jet · jug)
groups.blurb: The ONLY blend floor left after pass-7. j0 is the current FLOOR (Emma says the whole word, no segmentation) — your A/B anchor. Every other candidate attempts a real j-a-m segmentation with a different /dʒ/ onset lever. j4/j6 use a nested-prosody onset that the production RUNTIME resource 400s (bake-only); if one of those wins it ports as a full-fidelity-only render.

items.title: jam
items.context: /dʒ/ + /æ/ + /m/. jam is in the canonical short-a pack (a real session target). m is a continuant (bare IPA); only the /dʒ/ onset is the open question. The canonical hard case.

candidates.label: j0 — baseline (current FLOOR — whole word, no segmentation)
candidates.mechanism: The current production render for any /dʒ/ word: <prosody rate="-15%">word</prosody> + 450ms break + bare word. NO j-a-m segmentation. The A/B anchor — Emma just says the whole word.
candidates.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-GB-OliviaNeural"><prosody pitch="+0Hz" rate="-10%" volume="+0%"><prosody rate="-15%">jam</prosody><break time="450ms"/>jam</prosody></voice></speak>

candidates.label: j1 — d + ʒ split (stop burst, then held ʒːə)
candidates.mechanism: Render /dʒ/ as its two components: a clipped d-stop release (də) then a held ʒ + schwa tail (ʒːə). Models the affricate the way a phonics teacher segments it — d then the "zh" buzz.
candidates.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-GB-OliviaNeural"><prosody pitch="+0Hz" rate="-10%" volume="+0%"><phoneme alphabet="ipa" ph="də">j</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="ipa" ph="ʒːə">j</phoneme><break time="250ms"/><phoneme alphabet="ipa" ph="æ">a</phoneme><break time="250ms"/><phoneme alphabet="ipa" ph="m">m</phoneme><break time="250ms"/><break time="450ms"/>jam</prosody></voice></speak>

candidates.label: j2 — dʒːə (held affricate + schwa tail, the pass-7 trick)
candidates.mechanism: Single bare-digraph affricate dʒ with the pass-7 held + schwa-tail length mark (dʒːə) — the EXACT shape that recovered /v/ + /w/. Tests whether the "held continuant + schwa" lever generalises to the affricate.
candidates.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-GB-OliviaNeural"><prosody pitch="+0Hz" rate="-10%" volume="+0%"><phoneme alphabet="ipa" ph="dʒːə">j</phoneme><break time="250ms"/><phoneme alphabet="ipa" ph="æ">a</phoneme><break time="250ms"/><phoneme alphabet="ipa" ph="m">m</phoneme><break time="250ms"/><break time="450ms"/>jam</prosody></voice></speak>

candidates.label: j3 — dʒː (long affricate, NO schwa tail)
candidates.mechanism: Length-marked affricate dʒː with NO schwa tail — give the affricate more duration to articulate cleanly while avoiding any "-uh" coloration. (The tie-bar d͡ʒə was tried and renders byte-identical to j2 — Azure normalises the U+0361 tie bar away — so this distinct length-only lever replaces it.)

candidates.label: j4 — dʒ slowed (nested -25% envelope, like /f/+/s/+/v/+/w/)
candidates.mechanism: Bare affricate dʒ wrapped in the SAME nested <prosody rate="-25%"> + 150ms settle break that /f/+/s/+/v/+/w/ take in full-fidelity mode. No extra schwa — the slow envelope alone. BAKE-ONLY (runtime resource 400s nested onset).

candidates.label: j5 — ʒːə only (drop the d, held buzz alone)
candidates.mechanism: Drop the d stop-burst entirely — render just the held ʒ + schwa tail (ʒːə), the closest "j" buzz without the stop. Tests whether the d burst is the scratch source (a stop with no vowel to lean on).

candidates.mechanism: j1’s d-release split, but the ʒ half gets the nested <prosody rate="-25%"> + settle-break envelope (ʒːə slowed). Combines the component split with the pass-7 slow shape on the fricative half. BAKE-ONLY (nested onset).

groups.title: Deliverable 2 — isolated letter-sound /v/ "vvv" cross-benefit
groups.blurb: The 4 accepted-model-floor /v/ clips (#446). vv0 is the EXACT current production render — your A/B anchor. vv1–vv4 transplant the pass-7 blend /v/ win (held vːə + schwa-tail length mark @ -25%) onto the ISOLATED mnemonic. Hypothesis: the same lever that recovered van/web/wig may clean up the isolated /v/.

items.title: vvv — read ("Which letter says vvv?")
items.context: The read prompt — vvv sits before a "?" so the carrier gets question prosody; the mnemonic itself is what scratched.

candidates.label: vv0 — baseline (current production render — accepted model-floor)
candidates.mechanism: The EXACT live render (round-5 winner v2): <prosody pitch="-3st" rate="-15%" volume="-20%"><phoneme ph="və">vvv</phoneme></prosody>. The accepted model-floor (#446) — your A/B anchor.
